full_judgment:
102.(1) The High Court Division on the application of any person aggrieved, may give such directions or orders to any person or authority, including any person performing any function in connection with the affairs of the Republic, as may be appropriate for the enforcement of any of the fundamental rights conferred by Part III of this Constitution. 

 12. While Sub-Article 1 of Article 102 empowers this Court to entertain the application of a person raising allegations of violation of fundamental rights, Sub-Article 2(a) of Article 102 mandates this Court to hear an aggrieved person who claims to have suffered any legal injury and, thereby, pass necessary direction or make appropriate declaration. 

 (i) 	There shall be, at least, one Sub-Registry Office for each of the Upazilla of Bangladesh and the Complex of the Upazilla Sub-Registry should be housed at a convenient place within the vicinity of the Upazilla Head Quarter. Given the fact that while an Upazilla Head Quarter is communication-wise convenient for the people in addition to the availability of services from the office of the A/C Land regarding obtaining the papers relating to records-of-rights and also Banking services, both of which are vital for the registration of any deed /document at the Sub-Registry, the employees of the Sub-Registry Office and the deed writers shall feel secure and comfortable to work at Upazilla Head Quarter.
